discovery_target: Within-date percentile rank of clipped five-session return, learned only from mature prefix labels
inputs: 19 causal OHLCV values plus their same-close eligible-universe percentile ranks; rank population fixed before looking at outcomes
selection: Generate formulas on purged prefix only, orient on prefix only, retain nontrivial/nonredundant formulas stable in three subsequent TRAIN-only blocks. No evolution on calibration/policy/external outcomes.
downstream: Fixed weighted standard-scaler/logistic C=0.3 for rank-only and rank+formula arms; matched raw-19 Extra Trees as additional control. Same training/calibration/cohort; no test selection.
missing_evaluation: Exclude whole dates with incomplete outcomes and report coverage. Empty optional periods are unavailable; empty primary fails. Never drop individual unresolved stocks then rerank.
evaluation_role: Previously viewed historical development dates, not new independent final evidence
